subject.title: OpenAI realtime Talk OAuth fallback is disconnected and selects a private alpha model

question: Which explicit non-alpha Codex realtime protocol/model contract should OpenClaw support for the OAuth-only browser Talk fallback, after checking the pinned Codex runtime and obtaining OAuth-only browser proof?
rationale: The broker mismatch appears mechanically bounded, but selecting a permanent realtime protocol/model affects an advertised beta auth-provider path and cannot safely be inferred from the issue report or Platform-key evidence alone.

options.title: Verify and repair the current Codex route
options.body: Directly inspect the pinned Codex runtime, choose its supported public browser-realtime contract, restore the broker handoff, and require OAuth-only browser proof before merging.

options.title: Temporarily disable the OAuth fallback
options.body: Keep Platform API-key Talk available while hiding OAuth readiness until a supported Codex contract can be proven.

recommendation.title: Verify and repair the current Codex route
recommendation.body: Directly inspect the pinned Codex runtime, choose its supported public browser-realtime contract, restore the broker handoff, and require OAuth-only browser proof before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged Codex OAuth Talk implementation and are the closest feature-history owner for the broker and browser-session contract.
